market_regime: Inflationary, higher-for-longer regime: an Iran/war-driven oil spike has pushed WTI to ~$103 and the 10Y near 5%, with the Fed holding then expected to hike again into December rather than cut. Capital is rotating hard out of long-duration tech/communications (QQQ -5% 1m, AI capex 'gut check' fears) into energy, utilities, staples, healthcare and financials — a classic defensive/reflation tilt with VIX rising.

themes.name: Energy supply shock
themes.thesis: Energy is the clear momentum leader (+10.8% 1m / +19.7% 3m) on an Iran-war oil spike (WTI $103, +9% 1m) and war-related inflation keeping crude bid; post-midterm permitting-reform headlines add a policy tailwind for US production and infrastructure.

themes.name: Electric power & utilities
themes.thesis: Utilities are rallying (+8.1% 1m) as a defensive bid meets structural AI/data-center electricity demand (semiconductor industry power use at record highs); regulated and merchant power names benefit from load growth while bond-proxy demand returns despite high yields.

themes.name: Defensive healthcare & staples
themes.thesis: Health Care (+22.5% 3m) and Consumer Staples (+8.0% 1m) lead the defensive rotation as growth fears and sticky 3-year-high inflation push investors toward earnings stability and pricing power away from AI megacaps.

themes.name: Higher-for-longer financials
themes.thesis: Financials are quietly strong (+10.7% 3m) as the Fed skips cuts and is expected to hike again, steepening net-interest margins; large banks and insurers benefit from elevated rates and a firm dollar (DXY +2.3% 3m).

avoid.what: Megacap tech / AI-capex beneficiaries (NVDA, META, AMZN-style hyperscalers and neoclouds like CRWV)
avoid.reason: Nasdaq leadership is rolling over (QQQ -5% 1m) on an AI-capex 'gut check,' rising hyperscaler debt warnings, and slowing-growth fears — trend has turned against long-duration AI names.
Worst-performing sector (-7.4% 1m / -5.3% 3m) as ad-exposed, long-duration growth names de-rate under higher yields.
Gold is falling hard (-6.8% 1m / -10.3% 3m) despite high inflation, pressured by a stronger dollar and rising real yields — momentum is negative.

avoid.what: Long-duration bond proxies and rate-sensitive growth / unprofitable small caps
avoid.reason: 10Y near 5% with the Fed expected to hike again into 2026 penalizes duration and speculative balance sheets.
